questions.question: Which language pairing does the lesson recommend for each runtime?
options: Agno for TypeScript, Mastra for Python and Rust bindings together
Agno for Python (FastAPI-shaped), Mastra for TypeScript (Vercel AI SDK-shaped)
Both are Rust-first runtimes with absolutely no Python or TypeScript bindings at all
Both are Go-first runtimes built entirely for the Vercel ecosystem
questions.explanation: Agno is Python (FastAPI-shaped); Mastra is TypeScript (Vercel AI SDK-shaped).

questions.question: What is Agno's recommended production deployment shape?
options: A long-lived stateful daemon that keeps every single agent resident in memory permanently
A serverless cron worker that only polls for new agent tasks on a fixed schedule daily
A stateless session-scoped FastAPI backend; each request starts a fresh agent and session state lives in a DB
A WebSocket-only server that keeps one persistent open connection per agent instance
questions.explanation: Stateless FastAPI per request; session state externalized to a DB.

questions.question: What are Mastra's three primitives?
options: Actor, Message, Inbox, the classic actor-model trio
Plan, Worker, Solver, the planning-based agent trio
Node, Edge, State, the graph-execution trio
Agents, Tools, Workflows, Mastra's three primitives
questions.explanation: Agents (LLM + role), Tools (Zod-typed), and Workflows are Mastra's three primitives.

questions.question: Roughly what agent-instantiation cost does Agno target per its docs?
options: About 2 microseconds with about 3.75 KiB per agent
About 200 milliseconds and roughly 100 MiB per agent instance
About 1 full second and roughly 1 GiB of memory per agent
About 10 minutes and roughly 4 GiB of memory per agent
questions.explanation: Agno's docs cite about 2 microseconds and about 3.75 KiB per agent.

questions.question: What does Mastra's Unified Model Router give?
options: A queue that batches and rate-limits tool calls before sending them to the model
A single client surface for thousands of models across many providers
A vector database layer used for long-term semantic memory storage
A graph checkpointer that snapshots workflow state between steps
questions.explanation: Mastra's Unified Model Router cites 3,300+ models across 94 providers.

questions.question: When is perf-for-perf's-sake the wrong reason to pick Agno?
options: When the project is already running on Python 3.13 in production today
When the deployment target happens to be any AWS region outside us-east-1
When the workload is one slow agent call per request and overhead is not the bottleneck
When the observability stack already in use happens to be Langfuse instead
questions.explanation: 2 microseconds matters at chat fan-in scale, not for a single slow call per request.

questions.question: What licensing surface should you read carefully before forking Mastra?
options: There is no license file anywhere in the Mastra repository at all, ever
All of Mastra is licensed under the GPL, including every core package
Mastra requires signing a CLA but performs absolutely no other license review
ee/ directories are source-available rather than Apache 2.0 and restrict commercial use
questions.explanation: Mastra is Apache 2.0 except for ee/ which is source-available; check the restrictions before forking.
